title: Please, add just this one crucial thing
body:
I didn’t manage to check off my habit in time and it switched to 0, now I can only check back last week for some reason

Please, add an opportunity to set the streak manually for situations like that 

This would also help when I missed my habit and want to set the streak to 0, but I have to either delete the habit or wait 2 days til it starts again by itself, it’s not very convenient 

Thanks for the free app like this anyway, keep it up, hope you add this feature
author: dadbol

title: Focusing more than 60 minutes?
body: Hi, devs! I really like your app! But I don't have the opportunity to set a larger timer in the focus section. Can you add the ability to bet more than 60 minutes? For example, I want to focus for 1.5 hours or more.
author: Kai Greatnier

title: Thank you for this great app!
author: alex775647

title: Stripped of vital functions
body: App is great but it only adds frustration to the fact that it lacks ability to track more than one occurrence during a day. Say, you wanted have a walk twice a day. Even though you set it as 2 times a day, you’ll be able to set a checkbox only once. Another even more functionality missing is stats for more than a week. Seriously? Without it you not allowed to even call it a Habit tracker, let alone claim that it is done according to Atomic Habits
author: Lxglblst

title: Классное приложение
body:
Great app, but lacks detailed stats: number of times completed by month, longest period of completion. Add it please and it will be top.😊

Отличное приложение, но не хватает подробной статистики: количество выполненных раз по месяцам, самый длинный период выполнения. Добавьте, пожалуйста, и будет топ.

title: Make it a bit better
body:
Performing a task n-times per week.

The app is very simple and easy to use. The only thing it lacked for me was stats by week. I need to track a habit, my goal is 2 times a week. Even if I make that setting, accomplishing that goal is not noted because the data is calculated by total or number of consecutive days.
